brand.description: Founded in 1995 in Ben Tre - the land of lush green coconut trees, Ngoc Mai is proud to be the leading coconut candy brand in the Mekong region.
brand.description2: With over 25 years of experience, we always preserve the secret of making traditional candy passed down from generation to generation, combined with modern technology to create high-quality products.
